summary_short.zh: project-based-learning 是一个基于项目学习的教程合集，通过实际构建应用来掌握编程核心概念。区别于零散的语法教程，它提供从需求分析到实现、测试和部署的完整项目周期，覆盖 Python、JavaScript、Go 等多种语言。学习者可按难度选择项目，按步骤实践，从而积累真实开发经验。无论是初学者还是进阶者，都能从中找到合适项目，提升动手能力和问题解决技巧。

summaries.en: A curated collection of project-based tutorials that teach programming by building real-world applications, solving the problem of abstract learning. Unlike passive lectures, these guides emphasize hands-on construction, covering languages like Python, JavaScript, Go, and C++. Learners progress from simple toys to complex systems, gaining practical skills. Developers can choose a project matching their level, follow clear steps, and deploy results, making it ideal for self-taught programmers and bootcamp students seeking portfolio projects.

summary_short.zh: Meetily是一款本地运行的AI会议助手，采用Rust构建高性能管道，整合比标准Whisper快4倍的Parakeet模型实现实时语音转写，并支持说话人分离，最后通过Ollama本地模型生成会议摘要。在macOS或Windows上安装后，导入或录制会议音频即可获取带说话人标签的文字记录和精炼摘要。该工具无需云端处理，从源头杜绝数据外泄，特别适合对隐私敏感的远程团队、记者及法律从业者在离线环境中高效整理会议内容。

summaries.en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant that runs 100% locally, eliminating cloud dependency for sensitive conversations. Built on Rust, it leverages a 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper pipeline for live transcription and speaker diarization, with Ollama-powered summarization. This design ensures both speed and confidentiality. You can run it on macOS or Windows: simply install, point it to a meeting audio source, and receive real-time transcripts and concise summaries—ideal for remote teams, journalists, or anyone prioritizing data privacy.

summary_short.zh: Unity MCP 通过模型上下文协议（MCP）在 AI 助手与 Unity 编辑器之间搭建桥梁，让大语言模型能够管理资源、控制场景、编辑脚本并自动化工作流。其核心设计是利用 MCP 标准化 AI 与编辑器的交互，使集成更可扩展且健壮。技术亮点在于将 Unity 的脚本 API 封装为 MCP 工具，LLM 无需理解引擎细节即可调用。游戏开发者可接入 Claude、Gemini 等助手，自动执行批量材质替换、场景布局调整等重复任务，或构建理解上下文、辅助关卡设计的智能工具。

summaries.en: Unity MCP bridges AI assistants with the Unity editor via the Model Context Protocol, enabling LLMs to manage assets, control scenes, edit scripts, and automate workflows. Its key strength lies in standardizing AI-Editor interactions through MCP, making integrations extensible and robust. Developers can connect tools like Claude or Gemini to Unity, automate repetitive tasks, or build intelligent game design assistants that understand context.

summary_short.zh: Romm 是一款自托管复古游戏 ROM 管理器和播放器，旨在解决游戏收藏混乱和无法统一播放的问题。它通过自动刮削元数据和封面图，让用户可以在美观的 Web 界面中浏览和启动游戏。其技术亮点是集成了基于浏览器的模拟器，无需额外配置即可直接运行。你可以利用 Docker 快速部署，导入 ROM 文件后即可拥有一个自带模拟功能的统一游戏库，非常适合复古游戏爱好者和收藏家。

summaries.en: Romm is a self-hosted ROM manager and player that simplifies organizing and playing retro game collections. Its key technical insight is automatic metadata scraping and artwork fetching, combined with a web-based interface that launches games directly in the browser via integrated emulators. You can self-host it with Docker, import your ROM files, and instantly enjoy a unified, searchable library with built-in emulation—perfect for preserving and accessing classic games.

summary_short.zh: Terax-ai 是一个仅7MB的终端优先AI原生开发工作台，将智能代理嵌入命令行，解决开发者频繁切换IDE和AI工具的效率问题。其技术亮点在于使用Tauri构建原生终端外壳，结合Xterm.js和React UI，使AI代理能实时感知命令执行过程，提供上下文相关的建议或自动完成重复任务。你可以直接替换现有终端，体验AI辅助的自动补全、命令解释和错误调试，或通过自定义插件扩展代理能力，实现个性化工作流自动化。

summaries.en: Terax-ai is a lightweight (7MB) terminal-first AI-native development workspace that embeds intelligent agents directly into the command line, solving the problem of constant context switching between coding and AI assistants. Technically, it leverages Tauri for a native shell experience and a React-based UI inside the terminal (via Xterm.js), allowing AI agents to observe commands, output, and errors in real time to provide contextual suggestions and automations. Practically, developers can replace their existing terminal with Terax-ai to gain AI-powered autocomplete, error explanations, and the ability to create custom agent plugins for repetitive tasks.
